headlines.text: 2026 brought us this moment: Bayne & Ford left that name behind for good, stepping out as MegaBad after 2 matches under the old identity, on Dynamite.
That Wednesday in 2026, Garcia, Moxley & PAC touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.89.
Turning the clock back to 2026: Andrade El Idolo vs. Kenny Omega delivered a real highlight of the night on Dynamite, rated 8.04.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2026, when Ricochet vs. Jack Perry fought tooth and nail for the AEW National Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.33.
It was 2026 when Adam Page vs. Mark Davis met for the very first time on Dynamite, rated 6.92.
